candidates.alt: An office server room sealed off with quarantine tape and plastic sheeting, safety cones by the desk and chairs pushed back as if abandoned. A wall board counts zero days since outbreak, and a small tent card beside one monitor reads don't repeat ideas.
candidates.caption: Defense in depth.
candidates.concept: The mind-virus outbreak gets full hazmat quarantine theater; the fix that actually works is one sticky note.

candidates.alt: A three panel comic. First panel: a small plain robot at a help desk tells a customer robot with a locked account to try the help center. Second panel: the desk robot hangs mid transformation in a glowing cocoon of cables marked evolving while the customer waits. Third panel: the desk robot is now huge and gleaming with trophies behind it, and gives the same customer the same answer.
candidates.caption: Routing accuracy is up again.
candidates.concept: A support agent self-evolves between panels; everything about it upgrades except the answer.

candidates.alt: A server room in flames, smoke rising from the racks. A small robot stands at a large red emergency alarm lever, one finger raised but not pulling it. Its speech balloon reads 'Possibly, though it depends'. A wall monitor shows STATUS: ON FIRE.
candidates.caption: One hundred corrections later, the student has learned the only answer nobody marks wrong.
candidates.concept: An agent trained by a hundred teacher corrections hedges the question of whether the server room is currently on fire.

candidates.alt: A robot holds one coin at a vending machine whose display reads $1.50. Behind it, a formal queue: a notary stamping a document marked ATTESTED, an official holding a slip reading RISK: LOW, an open bank vault door, and a stonemason chiseling numbers into a granite monument. Inside the machine, the candy bar hangs mid-drop behind a small velvet rope.
candidates.caption: The candy bar clears in three business days.
candidates.concept: A robot buys a $1.50 candy bar through the full governed-payment ceremony: notarized attestation, risk pricing, a vault, and a stone settlement record.
